notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
easyPrerequisites:
Siren of the Silent Song doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
North Pole Patrol is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
description:
Activate Siren of the Silent Song using North Pole Patrol's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using North Pole Patrol's ability by tapping it, untapping Siren of the Silent Song
Siren of the Silent Song triggers, causing each opponent to discard and mill a card.
Repeat.
